entities.summary: Zacharia (Zekaarya) Ofri was an Israeli basketball player. He was captain of the Israeli National team that competed in the men's tournament at the 1952 Summer Olympics as well as in the 1953 European Cup in Moscow and the 1954 World Cup in Rio de Janeiro
